messages:
Sara (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Optimize playbook before next wk's roadmap review. Main asks: eval-triggered alerts, per-route batching suggestions, prefix/KV caching guidance, and quantization recommendations.
Jia (Eng-ML): +1. From ML side eval-alerts are highest-risk (false positives). Need thresholding, P0 customers only at GA? :thinking_face:
Marco (Infra): For caching we can enable prefix caching at the runtime level, but we'll need explicit TTL controls and a metric for cache-hit skew across models.
Claire (Solutions Eng): Customer asks: FinHealth wants deterministic rollout gating tied to eval sets. They want automated alerts when eval score drops >2% on key prompts.
Matt (Sales): Chiming in — two mid-market customers will only commit if quant recs include expected latency delta and fallback plan. They need a launch checklist.
Oliver (Eng-Platform): Proposal: MVP scope =
- Eval-triggered alerts (can target canaries only)
- Per-route batching hints (offline analyzer + on-node suggestion)
- Simple quant recs: recommend 8-bit/4-bit with estimated latency/cost delta
We leave full auto-quant for later.
Kevin (Data): For eval-alerts we should store per-prompt baselines. Suggest schema: prompt_id, baseline_score, window, alert_threshold. Small example:
```
{ \"prompt_id\": \"signup-flow-1\", \"baseline\": 0.92, \"window_days\": 7, \"threshold_pct\": 2 }
```
Sara (PM): Nice. Launch criteria draft:
- Alerts: false positive rate <10% in pilot, integrated to Slack + Console
- Batching recs: show >5% cost saving on 3 internal workloads
- Quant recs: latency/cost estimates within 15% of reality on standard benchmark
Claire (Solutions Eng): Can we add an \"customer-runbook\" deliverable for FinHealth and ACME? They need steps for rollback + A/B compare.
Marco (Infra): Ops note: need rollout flags by customer and a fallback path to non-quantized model. That adds infra work but moderate.
Jia (Eng-ML): Q: Who owns the \"recommender\" logic? ML or Platform? I'd prefer ML owns model-ranking; Platform owns instrumentation + UI.
Oliver (Eng-Platform): Agreed — split ownership. Platform will expose metric endpoints and UI, ML owns models and thresholds.
Matt (Sales): Timeline ask: customers pushing for Q2 pilot. Can we aim for an internal pilot in 5 weeks?
Sara (PM): Target: 6-week internal pilot, 10-week public beta if infra estimate holds. Action items:
- Jia: prototype alerting rules & baseline algorithm (this week)
- Oliver + Marco: infra flags + fallback plan (2 wks)
- Claire: customer runbooks and pilot onboarding (2 wks)
- Kevin: eval schema + small dataset (this week)
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: roadmap-review meeting on 1769999500
Sara (PM): OK — I'll update the roadmap doc and send to review. Thanks all :thumbsup:
